title: AlignFlow: Improving Flow-based Generative Models with Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2510.15038v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Flow-based Generative Models (FGMs) effectively transform noise into complex data distributions. Incorporating Optimal Transport (OT) to couple noise and data during FGM training has been shown to improve the straightness of flow trajectories, enabling more effective inference. However, existing OT-based methods estimate the OT plan using (mini-)batches of sampled noise and data points, which limits their scalability to large and high-dimensional datasets in FGMs. This paper introduces AlignFlow, a novel approach that leverages Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport (SDOT) to enhance the training of FGMs by establishing an explicit, optimal alignment between noise distribution and data points with guaranteed convergence. SDOT computes a transport map by partitioning the noise space into Laguerre cells, each mapped to a corresponding data point. During FGM training, i.i.d. noise samples are paired with data points via the SDOT map. Ali

translated_title: AlignFlow：利用半离散最优传输改进基于流的生成模型
translated_abstract: 基于流的生成模型（FGMs）能够有效地将噪声转化为复杂的数据分布。在FGM训练过程中引入最优传输（OT）来耦合噪声和数据，已被证明可以改善流轨迹的直线性，从而实现更有效的推理。然而，现有的基于OT的方法使用（小）批量的采样噪声和数据点来估计OT方案，这限制了它们在FGM中对大规模和高维数据集的可扩展性。本文提出了AlignFlow，这是一种新颖的方法，利用半离散最优传输（SDOT）来增强FGM的训练，通过在噪声分布和数据点之间建立显式的、具有收敛保证的最优对齐。SDOT通过将噪声空间划分为拉盖尔单元格来计算传输映射，每个单元格映射到相应的数据点。在FGM训练期间，独立同分布的噪声样本通过SDOT映射与数据点进行配对。
tldr: AlignFlow提出利用半离散最优传输（SDOT）在噪声分布与数据点之间建立显式的、具有收敛保证的最优对齐，从而提升基于流的生成模型的训练效果与可扩展性。
en_tdlr: AlignFlow leverages Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport (SDOT) to establish explicit, optimal alignment between noise distribution and data points with guaranteed convergence, improving the training and scalability of flow-based generative models.
